test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom for the sentence given below.

The detective suspected Shyam because of his odd behaviour while investing the scam.
solution:
The solution is **To smell a rat**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate idiom for 'The detective suspected Shyam because of his odd behaviour while investing in the scam.' is To smell a rat.
 
• It means ' to suspect or realize that something is wrong in a particular situation'
 
• Therefore **option 4 **is the correct option.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's discuss about *idioms:*

 
 
• ​A group of words established by usage as having a meaning not deducible from those of the individual words.
 
• For example:- 
 
 
• Get your act together - Get organized and do things effectively.
 
• Back against the wall - Stuck in a difficult circumstance with no escape.
 
• On cloud nine - Being very happy.
